**This is the first release of Discpress.** It packs your game discs into CHD files, right in your browser. Under the hood it's the real **chdman** from MAME 0.289, wrapped in a friendly app that fits in a single HTML file and runs on your phone or your computer. There's nothing to install, no account, and your files never leave your device.

## Download

**[⬇ discpress.html](https://github.com/PowerBeef/discpress/releases/download/v1.0.0/discpress.html)** (about 2.5 MB). That one file is the whole app, and it works offline. It's also listed under **Assets** at the bottom of this page.

## Get started

1. **Open the file.**
   - **Computer:** double-click it, and it opens in your browser.
   - **Android:** open it with Chrome or another browser.
   - **iPhone and iPad:** save it to the Files app, then open it with an app that can run web pages, such as Sitecase.
2. **Add your games.** Pick every file of a game together (the `.cue` *and* its `.bin` files), or drag them onto the page.
3. **Press Start all**, then **Save** or **Download** each CHD when it's ready. Keep the page open while it works.

## What's in 1.0

- **Real chdman output.** Standard CHD v5 files with the same data checksums as desktop chdman, ready for MAME, RetroArch, DuckStation, PCSX2, PPSSPP, Flycast and more.
- **Knows your games.** It reads each disc to find the console and serial number, then looks it up in a built-in copy of the Redump database (about 42,000 discs). A size and CRC-32 match marks the dump as verified.
- **Official names.** Files are named after the official title, like `Metal Gear Solid (USA) (Disc 1).chd`. You can type your own name, turn renaming off, or **Rename** a CHD you already have.
- **The right command, picked for you.** Create, extract, verify and inspect CD, DVD, hard disk and LaserDisc CHDs. The **Advanced** tab has every chdman command and option.
- **Fast.** Compression runs on all your CPU cores.
- **Big discs welcome.** Results are written to disk rather than memory, so multi-gigabyte DVD images work. On desktop Chrome and Edge, results can go straight into a folder you choose.
- **Made for phones.** Adapts to any screen, rotation and text size, in light or dark mode. On iPhone and iPad, **Save to Files** uses the share sheet.
- **Private.** No network requests at all; it even works in airplane mode.

## Supported systems

PlayStation, PlayStation 2, PSP, Saturn, Sega CD / Mega CD, Dreamcast, NAOMI, PC Engine CD / TurboGrafx-CD, PC-FX, Neo Geo CD, 3DO, CD-i, Amiga CD32 and CDTV, plus arcade hard disks and LaserDisc. CHDs can also be turned back into `.cue`/`.bin`, `.gdi` or `.iso`.

## Browsers

Safari 16.4+ (iPhone, iPad, Mac), Chrome and Edge 102+ (desktop and Android), and Firefox 111+. Older browsers keep results in memory, which limits how big a disc can be.

## Good to know

- Creating a CHD takes a few minutes per CD on a computer, and longer on a phone. **Faster to create** in Options trades a little size for a lot of speed.
- Hacks, translations and homebrew aren't in the Redump database, so they keep their original name. They convert just the same.
- Discpress doesn't include any games. Please convert only discs you own.

---

Discpress is free and open source under the BSD 3-Clause license, built on chdman from MAME and game data from Redump via libretro-database. See the [README](https://github.com/PowerBeef/discpress#readme) for the FAQ and build instructions. Not affiliated with the MAME team, Redump or libretro.
